title: SourceCandidates
description: Model-expanded census proposals (spec/53). NOT a governed artifact: candidates a human reviews before any enters the manifest. Locators here are unverified until checked against the live catalog.

issuer.description: Issuing agency or 'Congress' — required so the accepted manifest item has a non-empty issuer

family.description: e.g. statute, regulation, guidance, exam_manual, sro_rule_guidance

cfr_locator.description: US only: e.g. '12 CFR Part 1266' — omit if unsure; do not invent

usc_locator.description: US only: e.g. '12 U.S.C. 1430' — omit if unsure; do not invent

locator.description: Jurisdiction-appropriate citation for non-US sources, e.g. 'UK EMIR art. 9', 'Regulation (EU) 2019/834', 'FSMA 2000 s.137' — omit if unsure

url.description: Official URL to the source's full text. For UK use legislation.gov.uk; for EU use eur-lex.europa.eu; otherwise the issuing authority's official page. Always provide one for non-US sources so it can be verified and fetched.

rationale.description: One line: why this source is in scope
